name: Oriental Kopi Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司以 RM23.00 million 收购位于 Selangor 的租赁土地及厂房，用于扩大产能；同时宣布派发中期股息。最新一季营收同比增长 34.2%，但净利润同比减少 5.3%。
overview_en: This year the company proposed to acquire a parcel of leasehold land together with a factory building in Selangor for RM23.00 million to expand production capacity, and declared an interim dividend. Latest quarterly revenue grew 34.2% year-on-year while net profit declined 5.3% year-on-year.

segments.name: 包装食品分销
segments.note: 今年公司通过子公司收购 Selangor 的租赁土地及厂房，以扩大生产设施。
segments.note_en: This year the company, through its subsidiary, proposed to acquire leasehold land and a factory building in Selangor to expand production facilities.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Oriental Coffee International Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM23.00 million 现金收购位于 Selangor 的租赁土地及一座约 5,262 平方米的厂房。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Oriental Coffee International Sdn. Bhd. proposed to acquire a parcel of leasehold land together with a factory building measuring approximately 5,262 square metres in Selangor for a cash consideration of RM23.00 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述收购事项发布公告，该收购源于 2025 年 6 月 19 日的报价函。
actions.text_en: The company announced the proposed acquisition, which arose from a letter of offer dated 19 June 2025.
